name: Zip-wire elf
idea: Run string between two chair backs and hang the elf from it with a peg, mid-zip.

name: Marshmallow bath
idea: Elf sits in a mug or bowl full of mini marshmallows, as if it's a bubble bath.

name: Toilet roll snowman
idea: Elf has built a snowman from three loo rolls stacked up with a felt-tip face.

name: Stuck in the biscuit tin
idea: Elf is head-first in the biscuit tin with just the legs showing.

name: Fishing in the sink
idea: Elf on the tap with a pencil fishing rod and paper fish in a bowl of water.

name: Kindness note
idea: Elf leaves a note asking your child to do one kind thing for someone today.

name: Hide and seek
idea: Elf hides with a sign saying 'Bet you can't find me before breakfast'.

name: Teddy tea party
idea: Elf hosts the teddies round a tea set, a biscuit on each plate.

name: Snow angel in flour
idea: Elf lies in a tray of flour having made a snow angel.

name: Wrapped the remote
idea: Elf has wrapped the TV remote in wrapping paper with a 'no telly till tea' tag.

name: Selfie with the family photo
idea: Elf posed next to a family photo with a phone or a paper phone, taking a selfie.

name: Lego elf house
idea: Elf asleep in a little Lego or block bed with a tissue blanket.

name: Breakfast surprise
idea: Elf leaves cereal poured in a bowl with a note: 'Made you breakfast (didn't add milk, I'm not daft)'.

name: Reading a bedtime story
idea: Elf sits on the bed holding a Christmas book open, ready for tonight's story.

name: Toy car race
idea: Elf lines toy cars up on a paper start line with a chequered flag.

name: Hanging from the light
idea: Elf dangles from a lampshade or light pull by a ribbon (not a hot bulb).

name: Paper snowflakes
idea: Elf has cut paper snowflakes and stuck them on the window.

name: Sock snowball fight
idea: Elf and the teddies in two forts throwing rolled-up white socks.

name: Drawing on the banana
idea: Elf has drawn a funny face on every banana in the fruit bowl.

name: Elf jail
idea: Elf behind 'bars' of straws or pencils in a box for being cheeky, with a sorry note.

name: Countdown chain
idea: Elf leaves a paper chain with one link for each sleep left to Christmas.

name: Photo-booth props
idea: Elf leaves paper moustaches and hats on sticks for a family photo.

name: Helping with homework
idea: Elf sits on the reading book with a pencil and a note: 'I did the easy one'.

name: Bubble wrap road
idea: Elf laid a bubble wrap path from the bedroom door to the stairs.

name: Making a mug hot chocolate
idea: Elf by a mug with a hot chocolate sachet and 'For after school' tag.

name: Writing to Father Christmas
idea: Elf has started a letter to Father Christmas and left space for your child's list.

name: Playing a board game
idea: Elf mid-game of snakes and ladders against a teddy, and losing.

name: Tangled in fairy lights
idea: Elf wrapped in fairy lights (switched off) after trying to help with the tree.

name: Sweet scavenger hunt
idea: Elf leaves three clue notes leading to one small treat.

name: Bake-off judge
idea: Elf sits by gingerbread or biscuits holding a paper score card '10'.

name: Elf-sized doughnuts
idea: Elf on a plate of Cheerios like a pile of tiny doughnuts.

name: Clothes-peg washing line
idea: Elf has hung all the odd socks on a string washing line.

name: Kindness jar
idea: Elf starts a jar of kind things the family can add to all week.

name: Riding the dog's toy
idea: Elf riding a soft toy or the dog's teddy like a reindeer.

name: Gift for a neighbour
idea: Elf leaves a card for your child to write and pop through a neighbour's door.

name: Glitter sneeze
idea: Elf by a tissue box with a sprinkle of sugar 'glitter' and a 'bless me' sign.

name: Ski slope
idea: Elf skiing down a book ramp on two lolly sticks.

name: Elf movie night
idea: Elf on the sofa with a tiny popcorn cup and the remote, film night tonight.

name: Toothpaste message
idea: Elf wrote 'Brush for 2 mins!' on the bathroom mirror with soap or a dry-wipe pen.

name: Stuck to the fridge
idea: Elf held on the fridge door by magnets, looking very stuck.

name: Tree decorating
idea: Elf has hung one new decoration on the tree and points at it.

name: Paper aeroplane race
idea: Elf has folded paper aeroplanes and left a 'race me' sign.

name: Swapped the shoes
idea: Elf has swapped everyone's shoes round by the door.

name: Craft kit for later
idea: Elf leaves paper, glue and a note: 'Make me a hat after school?'

name: Hiding in the stocking
idea: Elf peeks out of a Christmas stocking with 'Not long now!'.

name: Snow in the shoe
idea: Elf filled one wellie with cotton wool 'snow'.

name: Treasure map
idea: Elf drew a map of the house with an X where a sweet is hidden.

name: Tissue box ghost train
idea: Elf pulling a train of toys in tissue boxes across the floor.

name: Thank-you card
idea: Elf asks your child to make a thank-you card for their teacher.

name: Elf yoga
idea: Elf and teddies doing yoga on a tea towel, one leg up.

name: Caught in the crisps
idea: Elf asleep in an open crisp packet (empty, folded neatly).

name: Kitchen roll mummy
idea: Elf wrapped up like a mummy in kitchen roll with a 'help' note.

name: Build a fort
idea: Elf built a fort from cushions and tea towels on the sofa.

name: Jigsaw night
idea: Elf has started a jigsaw with three pieces in, and a 'your turn' sign.

name: Elf-sized Christmas jumper
idea: Elf wearing a sock cut into a jumper (an old odd sock).

name: Popcorn garland
idea: Elf has threaded a popcorn or paper garland and draped it on a shelf.

name: Note from the North Pole
idea: Elf leaves a short 'North Pole News' about what the reindeer are up to.

name: Elf in a glass
idea: Elf sitting in a pint glass with a straw, 'fully refreshed'.

name: Domino run
idea: Elf has set up a domino or book run for your child to knock down.

name: Donation box
idea: Elf leaves an empty box: 'Pick one toy to give to children who need it'.
